questions.question: What is the simplified value of {( {(1)/({sec A + tan A )}} )²}
questions.solution:
To simplify the expression : {1/[(1/cosA) + (sinA/cosA)]}²

⇒ [cosA/(1 + sinA)]²

⇒ cos²A/(1 + sinA)²

⇒ 1 - sin²A/(1 + sinA)²

⇒ (1 – sinA)(1 + sinA)/(1 + sinA)²

⇒ (1 – sinA)/(1 + sinA)

questions.question: Two trains are moving in the same directions at speed of 43 km/h and 51 km/h respectively. The time taken by the faster train to cross a man sitting in the slower train is 72 seconds. What is the length (in metres) of the faster train?
questions.solution:
Given: The speed of 2 trains = 43 km/hr and 51 km/hr

Relative velocity of one train w.r.t. another = (51 - 43)km/hr = 8 km/hr

Relative velocity in m/s = 8 × (5/18) m/s

⇒ Distance covered by the train in 72 sec = 8 × (5/18) × 72 = 160

Since, this is the distance covered in crossing the man

Hence, the length of faster train = 160 m

questions.question: A solid cone of height 24 cm and radius of its base 8 cm is melted to form a solid cylinder of radius 6 cm and height 6 cm. In the whole process what percent of material is wasted?
questions.solution:
Volume of the cone = (1/3) π r² h = (1/3) π (8)² (24)

Volume of solid cylinder = π r² h = π (6)² (6)

Material wasted = Volume of the cone - Volume of solid cylinder

⇒ Material wasted = (1/3) π (8)² (24) - π (6)² (6)

⇒ % of Material wasted = {[(1/3) π (8)² (24) - π (6)² (6)] / (1/3) π (8)² (24)} × 100

⇒ [π (8)³ - π (6)²] / π (8)³] × 100

⇒ [(512 – 216) / 512] × 100

⇒ 57.8%

∴ the correct option is 3)

questions.question: Sandy and Mandy do (8/13)th part of a work and the rest of the work was completed by Andy. If Sandy, Mandy and Andy take the same work for Rs 2600, then what is the share (in Rs) of Andy?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sandy and Mandy do (8/13)th part of a work.

The rest of the work was completed by Andy.

Sandy, Mandy and Andy take the same work for Rs 2600.

**Formula used:**

W = E × T Where, W = Work, E = Efficiency, and T = Time

**Calculation:**

Let the amount of total work be a

Work done by Sandy and Mandy = 8a/13

Work done by Andy = a – 8a/13 = 5a/13

Total amount of money taken by the 3 people = Rs. 2600

⇒ Andy’s share = 2600 × [(5a/13)/a]

⇒ Andy’s share = Rs. 1000

**∴ The share (in Rs) of Andy is 1000.**

questions.question: If the expression px³ – 2x² – qx + 18 is completely divisible by (x² – 9), then what is the ratio between p and q respectively?
questions.solution:
Given : (x² – 9) is a factor of the given expression

⇒ x = 3, - 3

Putting values of x = 3, -3 in the given expression

We get,

⇒ p(3)³ – 2(3)² – q(3) + 18 = 0 and p(-3)³ – 2( -3)² – q(-3) + 18 = 0

⇒ 27p – 3q – 18 + 18 = 0 and -27p – 18 + 3q + 18 = 0

⇒ 27p = 3q

⇒ p/q = 1/9

∴ the correct option is 1)

questions.question: How many times the keys of a typewriter have to be pressed in order to write numbers from 121 to 1346?
questions.solution:
Here, every 3 digit number would need 3 presses and every 4 digit number would need 4 presses

⇒ 3 digit numbers from 121 to 999 = 999 – 121 + 1 = 879

⇒ 4 digit numbers from 1000 to 1346 = 1346 – 1000 + 1 = 347

So, total number of presses = (879) × 3 + 347 × 4 = 2637 + 1388

⇒ 4025

∴ the correct option is 4)

questions.solution:

⇒ ∠ECB = 180° – 2(84°) [ISOSCELES ∆]

⇒ ∠DCB = 180° - 78°

⇒ ∠DCB = 102°

So, ∠DCE = ∠ECB + ∠DCB

⇒ ∠DCE = 12° + 102°

⇒ ∠DCE = 114°

Since, BC = CE = DC [SIDES OF RHOMBUS ARE EQUAL]

In ∆DCE

⇒ ∠DCE + ∠CED + ∠EDC = 180°

⇒ ∠CED + ∠EDC = 180° - 114°

⇒ 2(∠DEC) = 66°

⇒ ∠DEC = 33°

∴ the correct option is 3)

questions.question: Average of 11 numbers is 7. If every number is doubled, then what will be the new average of the numbers?
questions.solution:
Average of 11 numbers = 7

⇒ Sum of all the numbers = 11 × 7 = 77

⇒ If every number is doubled, the total sum will also double

⇒ Sum of all the new numbers = 77 × 2 = 154

Average of new numbers = 154/11 = 14

∴ the correct option is 4)

questions.question: If the expression px³ – qx² – 7x – 6 is completely divisible by x² – x – 6, then what is the value of p and q respectively?
questions.solution:
Given: x² – x – 6 is a factor of the given expression

So, roots of x² – x – 6 will also be the roots of the expression

⇒ x² – x – 6 = x² – 3x + 2x – 6

⇒ x(x – 3) + 2(x – 3)

⇒ (x + 2) (x – 3)

So, x = - 2,3 are the roots of px³ – qx² – 7x – 6

Putting x = - 2,3 in the expression, we should get the value equal to 0

⇒ p( - 2)³ – q( - 2)² – 7( - 2) – 6 = 0 and p(3)³ – q(3)² – 7(3) – 6 = 0

⇒ - 8p - 4q + 14 – 6 = 0 and 27p – 9q – 21 - 6 = 0

⇒ 8p + 4q = 8 and 27p – 9q = 27

Solving both the equations, we get

⇒ p = 1, q = 0

∴ the correct option is 2)

questions.question: A trader sold an article at profit of 20%. Had he bought that article at 60% less price and sold it at Rs 90 less, then he would have gained 50%. What is the value (in Rs) of cost price?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price of the article = Rs. a

⇒ So, the actual selling price = a + (20/100)a = Rs. 1.2a

If he bought the article at 60% less price

⇒ Cost price would have been = a – (60/100)a = Rs. 0.4a

⇒ Selling price that would have been = Rs. 1.2a – 90

⇒ Gain % would have been = 50%

⇒ [(1.2a – 90) – 0.4a] / (0.4a) = 50/100

⇒ (1.2a – 90) – 0.4a = 20a/100

⇒ 0.8a – 90 = 0.2a

⇒ 0.6a = 90

⇒ a = 150

∴ the correct option is 1)

questions.question: If x + (1)/(x) = 5, then what is the value of {x⁵} + (1)/({{x⁵)}}?
questions.solution:
Given,

(x + 1/x) = 5

Squaring both sides

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 25

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 25 – 2 = 23 ----(i)

Again, doing cubes of both sides

⇒ (x + 1/x)³ = 125

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = 125 – 3(5) = 110 ----(ii)

By (i) and (ii)

⇒ (x² + 1/x²)( x³ + 1/x³) = 23 × 110 = 2530

⇒ x⁵ + (x + 1/x) + 1/x⁵ = 2530

⇒ x⁵ + 1/x⁵ = 2530 – 5

Required value: x⁵ + 1/x⁵ = 2525

**Trick: **

If x + 1/x = k then the value of x⁵ + 1/x⁵ will always be equal to (k⁵ – 5k³ + 5k)

Here k = 5

x⁵ + 1/x⁵ = k⁵ – 5k³ + 5k = 5⁵ - 5 × 5³ + 5 × 5 = 2525

∴ Answer is 2525

questions.question: If two successive discounts of 20% and 30% are given, then what is the net discount (in %)?
questions.solution:
Given: 2 successive discounts of 20% and 30%

Let a be the Principal value

⇒ Amount after 1st discount = a – (20/100)a = 0.8a

⇒ Amount after 2ⁿd discount = 0.8a - 0.8a × (30/100)a = 0.56a

So, net discount = a – 0.56a = 0.44a

⇒ % net discount = (0.44a / a) × 100 = 44%

∴ the correct option is 2)

questions.question: Amit donated 20% of his income to a school and deposited 20% of the remaining in his bank. If he is having Rs 12800 now, then what is the income (in Rs) of Amit?
questions.solution:
Let the total income of Amit be Rs. a

⇒ Amount donated to school = a × (20/100) = 0.2a

⇒ Remaining amount left with Amit = a – 0.2 = Rs. 0.8a

⇒ Amount deposited in the bank = 0.8a × (20/100) = 0.16a

⇒ Total remaining amount left with Amit = 0.8a – 0.16a = 0.64a

Now, 0.64a = 12800

⇒ a = 20000

So, the total income of Amit is Rs. 20000

∴ the correct option is 2)

questions.question: In triangle PQR, the sides PQ and PR are produced to A and B respectively. The bisectors of ∠AQR and ∠BRQ intersect at point O. If ∠QOR = 50°, then what is the value (in degrees) of ∠QPR?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

We know that the excenter of the triangle is the location where the bisectors of one internal angle and bisectors of two exterior angle bisectors of the opposite side of the triangle connect.

Here, O is the excenter

So, 90° - 1/2 (Opposite Angle) = Excenter angle

⇒ 90° - 1/2 × ∠QPR = ∠QOR

⇒ 90° - 1/2 × ∠QPR = 50°

**⇒ ∠QPR = 2 × (90° - 50°) = 2 × 40° = 80°**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/216e037d6d302daca56c8e91b1d98ade046c158aa1c13d54af2d1026de5c1e9e.png] 

In ∆PQR

⇒ ∠QPR + ∠PRQ + ∠RQP = 180°

Now,

⇒ ∠QPR + (180 – 2 × ∠OQR) + (180 – 2 × ∠ORQ) = 180°

⇒ ∠QPR + 180 – 2 × ∠OQR + 180 – 2 × ∠ORQ = 180° (i)

In ∆OQR

⇒ ∠OQR + ∠QRO + ∠ROQ = 180°

⇒ ∠OQR + ∠QRO° = 180 - 50° = 130°

Multiplying by 2

⇒ 2(∠OQR + ∠QRO°) = 260° (ii)

Substituting (ii) in (i)

⇒ ∠QPR + 360° – 260° = 180°

⇒ ∠QPR = 80°

**∴ the correct option is 3)**
